@syntax End Type
@syntax EndType
Ends a `Type` declaration. `End Type` and `EndType` mean the same thing.

```blitzbasic
;run
Type Box
	Field w%
EndType
b.Box = New Box
b\w = 3
Print b\w
```

```text
3
```
